findings.title: F4 attributes 73-84 % of HV6120 stall torque to flight 2's max-q hinge moment; the 73 % is a flight-1 (K850DM) case, and flight 2's own range is 77-84 % nominal-to-high or 64-84 % over the derived envelope
findings.contradicts: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md F4 (line 58): 'Stall during boost is an operating case on flight 2 (R23-REQUIREMENTS-05): the derived max-q hinge moment at large deflection is 73-84 % of the HV6120 stall torque (Inference)'. Inputs: tab 8 mm x 26.5 mm, hinge at the tab's forward edge (../../docs/VEHICLE.md 'Control tab'); REQUIREMENTS flight-envelope row, flight 2 max Mach 1.54-2.20, q_max 142-286 kPa; HV6120 5.4 kg.cm.

evidence.method: Same linear theory as the source (R23-REQUIREMENTS-05, hinge.py): dCp = 4 delta / sqrt(M^2-1), delta 15 deg, S = 8 x 26.5 mm, arm = 26.5/2 mm, stall 5.4 kg.cm = 0.5296 N.m; (Mmax, qmax) per case from the R23 flight1d_results.json that the envelope row cites (R23-REQUIREMENTS-01).
evidence.source_output: Re-running the R23 script: 'K850 qmax hi M1.65 q=172kPa d=15: 0.386 N.m = 73%'; 'L1000 nominal M1.82 q=212kPa d=15: 0.410 N.m = 77%'; 'L1000 hi M2.13 q=286kPa d=15: 0.447 N.m = 84%'. round23_requirements.json R23-REQUIREMENTS-05 'measured': '0.39-0.41 N.m (K850DM ...) and 0.41-0.45 N.m (L1000W ...)'. So 73 % is the K850DM high-q case; the L1000W figures are 77-84 %.
evidence.full_envelope: .supervisor/r28_requirements/hinge_all.py over all 18 L1000W cases: 63.9 % (dry 2.7 kg, Cd x1.3, 1200 m site: M1.59, q 142.2 kPa, 0.338 N.m) to 84.3 % (dry 1.6, Cd x0.8, 0 m: M2.13, q 285.5 kPa, 0.447 N.m); table in hinge_l1000w.txt.
evidence.not_elsewhere: grep of docs/ and sources: '73-84' appears only in REQUIREMENTS F4 and the R23 review files.

findings.impact: The flight-2 figure that motivates F4's stall-as-operating-case rule is mis-stated at its lower end (taken from flight 1). The conclusion (up to about 84 % of stall at 15 deg near max q, so stall is plausible) is unchanged; no board impact.
findings.concrete_fix: F4 text: 'flight 2's derived max-q hinge moment at 15 deg is about 64-84 % of the HV6120 stall torque over the derived envelope (77-84 % nominal to high; supersonic linear theory, Inference)'.

findings.title: The flight-envelope note asks to re-check 'the Temperature row's 525 s', but the Temperature row no longer contains 525 s (it says about 1200 s since round 23)
findings.contradicts: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md line 36: 'Re-check F5's window, the pad-energy Q_flight and the Temperature row's 525 s against the new envelope.' versus the Temperature row (line 93): 'flight 2 lasts up to about 1200 s under a 36 in chute (derived envelope, Inference)'.

evidence.grep: '525' occurs in REQUIREMENTS.md only at line 36 (and an unrelated R7 BOM row, line 194); the Temperature row has '1200 s'.
evidence.history: git log -S: 'Temperature row's 525 s' was added in ec8cb98 (round 21); 'lasts up to about 1200 s' replaced 'lasts up to 525 s' in 9b27268 (round 23, R23-REQUIREMENTS-01 fix), which left line 36 unchanged.

findings.impact: The requirements file states a figure the Temperature row does not contain and lists as open a re-check that round 23 already made; a reader re-doing the Temperature item looks for a 525 s that is not there. No board impact.
findings.concrete_fix: Line 36: drop 'and the Temperature row's 525 s' (done in round 23: 1200 s), keeping the F5 window and Q_flight re-checks, or reword to 'the Temperature row's flight duration (now about 1200 s)'.
